PC Game

GrappleGroove

A first-person platformer built around two grappling hooks and momentum: swing, reel in and let go at the right moment to fly across a giant toy-filled playroom. The campaign walks through hand-designed levels that each teach one idea. The same level editor used to build them ships in the game: place pieces, test from the camera, set a par time by playing, then publish the level for everyone. Speedrun leaderboards race your best ghost, co-op sessions join by code, and the music is generated live from a toybox of mallets and bells. Built for Steam, with a browser version to try now.

Features

  • Two grappling hooks driven by momentum physics
  • Campaign of hand-designed levels
  • In-game level editor with instant test runs
  • Publish and play community levels
  • Speedrun leaderboards with your best ghost
  • Online co-op sessions joined by code
  • Procedural toybox music

Technologies

Unity 6 C# URP UI Toolkit Netcode for GameObjects Firebase WebGL
